'''Mike Nowoki''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Endor Regionals]] on 8 June 2002 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]] and [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him Mains]], according to Jason Herrin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3728">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-11-endor-regional-6-8-02d3728/ endor-regional-6-8-02], DeckTech (Jason "Mr. Black" Herrin, 11 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-11-endor-regional-6-8-02d3728/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
